### Wolverine Worldwide Announces Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Conference Call for November 12, 2026


October 29, 2026


ROCKFORD, Mich.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Wolverine World Wide, Inc. (NYSE: WWW) today announced that it expects to report its third quarter fiscal 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at approximately 6:30 a.m. ET. Following the press release, the Company will host a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET to review results and discuss current business trends.


Investors and analysts interested in joining the call are invited to dial 1-833-461-5787 (international callers, please dial 1-585-542-9983) and enter Meeting ID 204388096 when prompted. Please dial in approximately five minutes prior to the start of the call. The conference call will be broadcast live and available for replay within approximately 30 minutes after the conclusion of the call through November 12, 2027, at[investors.wolverineworldwide.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.wolverineworldwide.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54629003&newsitemid=20261028738656&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.wolverineworldwide.com&index=1&md5=27f035dc8b1884a74a08b7a2bd4705fc) under “Events & Presentations”.
